payments-bot: Payment failed for INV-5118 (decline_code: card_declined). Attempt 1.

zoe_finance: Flagging 020 Labs invoice. Large renewal. Sent initial notice earlier but no reply.

ales_support: Customer replied on the ticket: card decline, wants to wire funds today. Asked for wire instructions and confirmation we won't suspend service while ACH/wire is in flight.

zoe_finance: We can accept a wire. Per policy do not mark paid until funds clear. Pause dunning and auto-cancel for 72 hours. @ivy_accounting please hold dunning and set invoice state to "pending - bank transfer".

ivy_accounting: Pausing dunning 72h and marking pending. When they paste bank confirmation (amount + reference + bank trace) I'll reconcile. If AM approves, we can provision while in-flight but need a sales sign-off.

carlos_sales: AM can approve provisional provisioning if wire is initiated and we get a written confirmation from their treasury + copy of the payment instruction. Shared contact details with customer.

zoe_finance: Wire instructions (masking account digits) - use this verbatim and request they include INV-5118 as reference:

```
Bank: East Bay Commercial Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: ****2244
Routing/ABA: 444000888
SWIFT/BIC: EBCBUS33
Reference/Memo: INV-5118
Amount: USD 120,000.00
```

ales_support: Sent instructions to customer at 15:12 PT and asked them to reply here with bank confirmation when the transfer is initiated. Included invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-5118

zoe_finance: Scheduling one card retry 36 hours from now in case they update card after contacting their bank. If wire confirmation arrives before retry, I'll cancel it.

payments-bot: Scheduled retry set for 1746362399 (36h).

ivy_accounting: Please CC accounting on the customer's confirmation email to speed reconciliation. When wire posts, paste the bank's confirmation (txn id, posted date, amount) here and I'll apply payment. If they ask for beneficiary verification, confirm legal name and address: Redwood Inference, Inc., 123 Infra Rd, San Francisco CA.

carlos_sales: I'll follow up with AM and keep this thread updated. If no confirmation by EOD +3, escalate to collections. :exclamation:
